justification: ParserConfiguration.java has strong fan-out: it imports validator/postprocessor infrastructure, its LanguageLevel enum wires validator/postprocessor pairs for the supported Java versions, and its constructor registers five Processor implementations that depend on CommentsInserter, UnicodeEscapeProcessingProvider, LineEndingProcessingProvider, ProblemReporter, SymbolResolver, LexicalPreservingPrinter, and DefaultLexicalPreservingPrinter. Fan-in is also high: `rg -l "ParserConfiguration" javaparser-core/src/main/java` found 20 production files using it, including JavaParser.java, StaticJavaParser.java, CommentsInserter.java, Node.java, and several validator/utility classes; 156 test files also reference it.
